name: Whole-Home Renovation Planning: How to Prepare for a Major Project
description: Establish a clear, detailed scope: Define exactly what areas will be renovated and what changes you envision for each. This isn't just about aesthetics; it includes functionality and system upgrades.

step.text: Establish a clear, detailed scope: Define exactly what areas will be renovated and what changes you envision for each. This isn't just about aesthetics; it includes functionality and system upgrades.

step.name: Step 2: Assess existing conditions thoroughly: Get a professional to inspec…
step.text: Assess existing conditions thoroughly: Get a professional to inspect your home's foundation, roof, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems. Hidden issues can drastically alter plans and costs.

step.name: Step 3: Plan for temporary living and logistics: Decide where your family w…
step.text: Plan for temporary living and logistics: Decide where your family will live during the major construction phases, and arrange for storage, temporary utilities, and access to the site.

step.name: Step 4: Budget for the unexpected: Allocate a 15-20% contingency fund to co…
step.text: Budget for the unexpected: Allocate a 15-20% contingency fund to cover any unforeseen issues, especially common in older homes where concealed conditions often arise.
